verdict.rationale: ReadMe has several many-items-at-once capabilities. Docs Audit runs Linter rules against every page in a single pass, and Reusable Content updates every instance of a block when you edit it once. Branches save changes across many pages together, and Git sync, the ReadMe API and the rdme CLI give programmatic paths for working across many pages. However, no documented bulk edit, move, delete or update action across many items was found; most bulk change has to go through Git or API scripting. Missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/move/delete operations across pages, documentation of batch API endpoints, hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
